## Enlivex Announces Randomization of 135 Patients in Phase 2b Trial of Allocetra in Age-Related Primary Moderate-to-Severe Knee Osteoarthritis


*135 patients, out of a total planned 182, have been randomized and were administered the first injection of AllocetraTM; enrollment actively ongoing at clinical sites in the United States and in Europe*


*Topline six-month data expected by mid-2027*


*Phase 2b builds on positive three- and six-month Phase 1/2a data, which supported FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation granted in July 2026*


**Nes-Ziona, Israel, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Enlivex Ltd. (Nasdaq: ENLV) (“Enlivex” or the “Company”), a quality longevity company powered by a prediction markets treasury, today announced that 135 patients, out of a total planned 182, have been randomized and were administered the first injection of AllocetraTM in the Company’s Phase 2b clinical trial of Allocetra™ for the treatment of patients with moderate-to-severe age-related symptomatic primary knee osteoarthritis (OA). The trial is actively recruiting at clinical sites in the United States, Denmark and Poland, and the Company expects to report topline six-month data by mid-2027.


The global, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b trial is designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of intra-articular injections of Allocetra™ in patients aged 64 and older with moderate-to-severe age-related symptomatic primary knee OA, the population for which the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted RMAT designation. Key efficacy endpoints include changes from baseline in pain and function compared with placebo, measured at three and six months following treatment. Additional endpoints include changes in quality-of-life measures and functional mobility assessments.


Einat Galamidi, M.D., Chief Medical Officer of Enlivex, commented, “We are very excited by the progress of our Phase 2b trial. Reaching more than 70% of randomization in the trial reflects strong engagement from our investigators and patients across the United States and Europe. Our team is committed to executing this study to the highest standards of quality and in accordance with our stated timelines, and we look forward to reporting topline six-month data by mid-2027.


**About Enlivex (Nasdaq: ENLV)**


Enlivex is a quality longevity company powered by a prediction markets treasury. The Company is advancing Allocetra™, an advanced clinical-stage immunotherapy targeting inflammatory conditions associated with aging, with a primary focus on age-related osteoarthritis. In addition to its clinical programs, Enlivex operates a prediction markets treasury strategy built around the Rain protocol, the leading decentralized prediction markets infrastructure on Arbitrum. This dual strategy combines the development of quality longevity therapeutics with exposure to the emerging prediction markets ecosystem.


**About Knee Osteoarthritis**


Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is one of the most prevalent and disabling diseases worldwide, affecting more than 32 million Americans today and projected to impact 78 million Americans by 2040. There are currently no approved disease-modifying therapies; treatment is largely limited to pain relief, intra-articular steroids, or surgery, and the burden increases sharply with age. By age 60, KOA affects roughly 30% of the population, and about half of knee OA patients are 60 years and older. This demographic is expanding with global aging trends, underscoring the need for new, durable therapies.
